title: Reversible restart and state reconstruction
purpose: Exercise process restart and reconstruction of reversible lab state while collecting evidence that upstream regtest behavior outside the isolated experiment path remains unchanged.
assumptions: The scenario uses only local regtest instances.
The isolated experiment can be disabled without changing Bitcoin Core outside the experiment path.
No production recovery authority or key-custody rule is implied.

steps.action: Record the experiment-off regtest state and process identity before restart.
Prepare reversible experiment metadata required only for lab reconstruction.
Restart the local regtest process and reconstruct the reversible lab state without assigning production recovery authority.
Disable the isolated experiment and compare the resulting experiment-off observations with the baseline.

decision_gates: Any post-quantum signature scheme selection requires explicit user review.
Any hybrid authorization or Bitcoin consensus semantics require explicit user review.
Any activation, fork deployment, legacy or lost UTXO treatment requires explicit user review.
Any recovery authority, trust-root, key-custody, or production security semantics require explicit user review.
